Mild for two $14 or four $19. Make it spicy +$1. Salsa 4 Way $13 Homemade salsas: Fresca, Roasted Salsa Verde, Pineapple Jícama & Fire Roasted Tomato. Add guac +$3. Queso Fundido $16 Mexican chorizo, red pepper, poblano, onion & garlic with crispy corn tortilla chips & salsa fresca. Small Plates & Appetizers *Diego’s Original Nacho $18 Individually dressed nachos with your choice of: chicken tinga, ground beef, pulled pork OR roasted veggies; pico de gallo, fresh guacamole, melted cheese, scallions, Diego’s aioli & crispy chips. Summer Ceviche $17 Fresh Ahi tuna & shrimp, watermelon, red onion, pickled pomegranate & Aji Amarillo Leche de Tigre Baja Crispy Calamari $15 Hand cut New England calamari & peppers served with Diego’s aioli. Spicy Sautéed Calamari $15 Hand cut calamari with sweet corn, rioja sauce & grilled corn tortillas. Empanadas $14.5 Adobo duck, Oaxaca cheese & caramelized onion empanadas served with spicy duck gravy. #11 Rangoons $13 Butternut squash, cream cheese, shishito pepper & spicy shrimp rangoons with cilantro Thai chili sauce. Diego’s Crack Fries $13 Hand-cut crispy potatoes with Baja cheese, queso fundido, pickled jalapeño, mole spice & black pepper. Make ’em Dirty Donald with spicy duck gravy +$2. Perfect Quesadilla $15 Chicken tinga, Baja cheese, Diego’s aioli & black beans; sides of pico & guacamole. Sub carne asada steak +$3. Tacos — 2 per order on 6" tortillas Add Spanish rice & beans to make it a meal for +$5 Blackened Shrimp Chimichurri $17 On grilled flour tortillas with Napa cabbage, avocado & chef’s chimichurri. Street Tacos $16 Blue corn tortillas, Cotija, fresh slaw, pico, shaved radish & cilantro. Choice of chicken tinga, pulled pork, ground beef or roasted veggies; side of Diego’s aioli. Le Rev Beef Taco $17 Braised beef, spicy Le Rev sauce, white onion, cilantro & Cotija on flour tortillas. Korean Pork Belly Tacos $17 Crispy pork belly on flour tortillas with house pickled veggies, spicy kimchi, citrus Cholula aioli & toasted sesame. Carne Asada Steak Tacos* $18 Flat iron steak on blue corn tortillas with shaved iceberg, roasted tomato salsa, Baja cheese, lime crema, white onion & cilantro. Fish Tacos $16.5 Pan-seared cod on grilled flour tortillas with Baja cheese, slaw, pico de gallo, pineapple jícama slaw & Diego’s aioli. *Available with fried cod. Tuna Poke Tacos* $17 Fresh Ahi tuna, Napa cabbage, citrus Cholula aioli, cucumber, avocado, togarashi, soy ginger & toasted sesame on blue corn tortillas. Fried Chicken Tacos $16.5 Grilled flour tortillas with refried beans, slaw, crispy bacon, Oaxaca cheese, pickled habanero onions & citrus Cholula aioli. Diego’s Pocket Friendly Combo — Loaded burrito (chicken tinga or roasted veggies) with Spanish rice, black beans, pico, shaved lettuce & Baja cheese, served with an ice cold Tecate Cerveza plus chips & salsa. $18 (tax included) Side Dishes to Share Mexican Street Corn Off the Cob $11 — Refried Beans $6 — Crispy Potatoes with Lime Crema & Cotija $8 — Spanish Rice & Beans $7.5 — Buffalo Cauliflower with Pepitas $8 — Herb Roasted Mushrooms in Savory Queso Cream $9 — Crispy Brussels with Ponzu & Garlic Aioli $10 — Shaved Brussels $7 — Burritos Barbacoa $16.5 Tequila-lime marinated pulled pork with Negra Modelo BBQ, Diego’s aioli, fresh slaw, Baja cheese, black beans, Spanish rice & pico; griddled wheat or flour tortilla. With fresh jalapeño purée & house lime pickles. Cheesy Shrimp & Corn $17 Crispy shrimp, street corn, Spanish rice, queso fundido, Baja cheese & iceberg. Cali $16 Chicken tinga, ground beef, pulled pork, smoked tofu or upgrade to baby shrimp or carne asada +$3; griddled tortilla with crispy potatoes, pico, guacamole, slaw, Baja cheese & black beans; side of Diego’s aioli. Buffalo Cauliflower $15.5 Oaxaca, arugula, black beans & avocado in flour tortilla with buffalo sauce. Dinner Plates Diego’s Crunch Wrap $22 Savory ground beef, guacamole, lettuce, queso, crispy corn tortilla & sour cream in a griddled flour tortilla; with pico & Spanish rice. Birria Taco Platter $25 Jalisco-style beef birria tacos with rice, refried beans, pico, Baja cheese, chopped onion, cilantro & consommé. House Enchiladas $25 Street corn, veggies, Baja cheese, rice & beans; choose filling (chicken tinga, ground beef or roasted veggies) & sauce (Ranchero red or Suizas Verde green). Chicken Fajitas $25 Agave chipotle grilled chicken thigh, queso fundido, black beans, Spanish rice, salsa verde, guacamole & pickled onions; corn tortillas. Sub grilled flat iron steak +$8; blackened shrimp +$4. Steak Frites* $33 Grilled flat iron steak over crispy potatoes & sautéed shaved Brussels with cilantro garlic butter & fruit pico de gallo salsa. Drunken Burrito $21 Spanish rice, Baja cheese, black beans, salsa ranchera & guajillo sauce with pico, queso & guacamole; choice of pulled pork, chicken tinga or ground beef. Soups & Salads Spicy Butternut Squash Bisque $14 With lime crema & pepitas; served as a cup with a mini roasted mushroom & goat cheese quesadilla for dipping. Mexican Chicken Tortilla Soup Cup $8.5 / Bowl $13 Savory chicken & tomato broth with tender pulled chicken, crispy tortilla & veggies. Arugula & Street Corn Salad
